title: redact: user@host.local is counted as an email
head: aa0e3ec7cbbc8df0620d133764f392f6bc07cbed
testCommands: go vet ./... ; GOOS=linux GOARCH=amd64 go vet -tags nogui ./... ; GOOS=windows GOARCH=amd64 go vet ./...
go build ./... ; GOOS=linux GOARCH=amd64 go build -tags nogui ./... ; GOOS=windows GOARCH=amd64 go build ./...
testsAdded: TestLocalHostIsNoEmail: ssh/curl/vnc to user@host.local, pi@nas.local:8080 and me@macbook.local go unmasked, while a name on a real domain in the same sentence is still masked
unverifiedBoundaries: No live gateway run: the rule is exercised through Mask with Personal on, the same entry the gateway's masker takes.
Only the .local suffix is added; other reserved mDNS/private suffixes (.lan, .home.arpa) are untouched because no report covers them.
